textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
local name = game.getMonsterName(element:parent()("MonsterID"):GetInt())
if(string.len(name) > 9) then name = (string.sub(name, 0, 8).."...") end
component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.19*(lua_sys.screenWidth()/480.0)) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString(name) component("layer"):SetString("Clipping")

spriteSheetComponent.name: Sprite
spriteSheetComponent.event:
local spriteString = "monster_level_numbers_" local level = game.monsterLevel(element:parent()("MonsterID"):GetInt()) if(level < 10) then spriteString = (spriteString.."0") end
spriteString = (spriteString..level) component("spriteName"):SetString(spriteString) component("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/breeding01.xml") component("size"):SetFloat(0.5*(lua_sys.screenWidth()/480.0)) component("layer"):SetString("Clipping")

touchComponent.name: Touch
touchComponent.event: if(component("dragged"):GetInt() == 0) then if(game.monsterLevel(element("MonsterID"):GetInt()) < 4) then game.displayNotification("NOTIFICATION_MONSTER_UNDERLEVELED") else if(element("disabled"):GetInt() == 0) then element["bg"]["GreySprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0) element["bg"]["YellowSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(1) local selectedEntry = (""..element:name()) element:root():GetElement(element("List"):GetString())("NewSelectedEntry"):SetString(selectedEntry) element:root():GetElement(element("List"):GetString())("NewSelectedEntryID"):SetString(element("MonsterID"):GetInt()) element:root():GetElement(element("List"):GetString()):DoStoredScript("selectNewEntry") end end end

template.event:
local monsterId = element("MonsterID"):GetInt() local numGenes = game.numGenes(monsterId) local previous = nil
element("NumGenes"):SetInt(numGenes)
for i=0,numGenes-1 do
local geneItem = menu:addTemplateElement("template_elementicon", ("geneItem"..i), element)
geneItem("SpriteName"):SetString(game.geneType(monsterId, i)) geneItem("SheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/hud01.xml") geneItem("Size"):SetFloat(0.25*game.hudScale()) geneItem("Layer"):SetString("Clipping")
if(previous == nil) then geneItem:setParent(element) geneItem:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(8, 0, -1, lua_sys.RIGHT, lua_sys.VCENTER)) geneItem:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.RIGHT, lua_sys.VCENTER) else geneItem:setParent(previous) geneItem:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(-2, 0, 0, lua_sys.RIGHT, lua_sys.VCENTER)) geneItem:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.LEFT, lua_sys.VCENTER) end
previous = geneItem
geneItem:init() geneItem:setPositionBroadcast(true)
end
